stem.text: Compound X, $\text{C}_4\text{H}_8\text{O}_2$, has an unbranched carbon chain. An aqueous solution of X has an approximate pH of 3.
Compound Y, $\text{C}_3\text{H}_8\text{O}$, is a secondary alcohol.
X and Y are reacted together in the presence of a little concentrated sulfuric acid to form Z as the major organic product.
